======================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Yogendra Kumar Singh, Advocate
 For the Respondent/s : Mr. Md. Khurshid Alam, Aag-12
 Mrs. Nutan Sahay, A.C to Aag-12
 For the Nhai : Mr. S. N.Pathak, S.C.
 Mr. Saurav Nikunj, Advocate
 ======================================================
CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PARTHA SARTHY  ORAL ORDER 15 23-03-2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

Relying on the fourth supplementary counter affidavit filed on behalf of the respondents learned counsel for the State submits that the land in question of the petitioners was acquired vide notification dated 5.6.2012 for widening of N.H-30.
100% compensation amount to the tune of Rs.42,79,770/- has been paid to petitioner no.1 while Rs.4,90,034/- has been paid to the petitioner no.2.

Learned counsel submits that there being no clear partition with respect to the plots in question and different claims having been raised with regard to compensation, the brothers of the petitioners have file objections on 2.2.2017 against the petitioner no.1 having received the compensation.

It is further submitted that on the basis of the order passed by the District Land Acquisition Officer on 21.2.2017 in L.A Case no. Patna High Court CWJC No.22469 of 2019(15)
dt.23-03-2023 26 of 2012-13, Case no.717 of 2017(P) has been initiated.

sentences.text: Thus, the matter having been referred to under section 3H(4) of the National Highways Act, 1956, the writ application be disposed of directing the petitioners to pursue the matter there.
With respect to petitioner no.1, the Court does not find any statement in the counter affidavit with respect to payments of compensation to petitioner no.1 against the plot nos. 1641 and 1678.
There is also no statement with respect to payment of compensation to petitioner no.2 with respect to plot nos. 1641, 1678 and 1680.
